links.outcome: LLM CIU classification performance across aphasia severity strata
links.effect: Performance varied by discourse severity, with the weakest results in more severe aphasia; viable models showed high recall but lower precision (few-shot F1 0.776 to 0.817).
links.quote: Performance also varied by discourse severity, with the weakest results in more severe aphasia.

unlisted_practices: Few-shot versus zero-shot prompting to improve LLM classification accuracy
Fixed global versus per-chunk local few-shot example selection
LLM scoring as a human-in-the-loop component of aphasia discourse assessment

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM zero-shot and few-shot capability to score Correct Information Units from aphasic discourse transcripts against human consensus ratings on a test dataset.
